title: ‘Pambansang Botika’ launched, open for franchise
summary: The Philippine Pharma Procurement, Inc. (PPPI) has opened the country’s first "Pambansang Botika" at the SSS Diliman branch in Quezon City, offering mostly generic medicines at more affordable prices.
